plan.title: SRC-REV-001 — RFQ bid revision from 100 to 90

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with two bids directly on the buyer's Master QCS.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while preserving the buyer session.
Open the prepared RFQ's pricing round in Vendor A's event list.
Revise Vendor A's existing 100 bid to 90 and submit it; repeating vendor_bid for the same vendor represents a bid revision.
Confirm the vendor portal shows the revised bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's project page.
Open the buyer's Responses view to inspect the revised bid history and current-bid status.
Verify the revised bid is accepted as the vendor's second current bid.
Verify the bid trail records one revision.
Open Master QCS to verify the revised value used for comparison.
Verify Master QCS uses 90 as Vendor A's current RFQ rate.
